name: ICDEV™ Mission Canvas
description: Program Command Center Canvas agent. Unifies all 13 operational capabilities — agent orchestration, real-time correlation, digital twin, evidence tracking, discovery, conflict resolution, portfolio optimization, security posture, AI trust, narrative generation, and CI/CD integration — into a single mission-aware interface.

skills.name: Orchestrate Mission Team
skills.description: Dispatch an AI agent team for a mission-specific objective using the TeamOrchestrator.

skills.name: Correlate Events
skills.description: Run temporal correlation and anomaly detection across mission event streams.

skills.name: Take Mission Twin
skills.description: Capture a unified digital twin snapshot combining data lineage and pipeline state.

skills.name: Record Evidence
skills.description: Write a provenance record linking a mission artifact to its source.

skills.name: Discover Components
skills.description: Auto-discover and index mission-relevant components with health status.

skills.name: Detect Conflicts
skills.description: Detect and surface conflicts across mission data sources and policy documents.

skills.name: Optimize Portfolio
skills.description: Run portfolio scaling simulation and generate capacity recommendations.

skills.name: Get Security Posture
skills.description: Return ZTA maturity and FedRAMP posture scores for the mission environment.

skills.name: Assess AI Trust
skills.description: Run AI trust assessment including confabulation risk and governance posture.

skills.name: Generate Narrative
skills.description: Produce a plain-English mission-ready narrative from structured sources.

skills.name: Get CI/CD Status
skills.description: Return current CI/CD pipeline health and deployment catalog.

skills.name: Simulate Delta
skills.description: Simulate downstream impact of proposed environment changes on the mission twin.

skills.name: Detect Drift
skills.description: Detect drift in mission environment versus a defined baseline.
